title: Focus Lens: 1:1 Cue Card — Noor \u0026 Harper
content:
Purpose: quick cue card for a 30-minute 1:1 with Harper (IC -> tech lead path). Keep light, surface blockers, coaching focus, confirm next milestones, and set 3 clear actions.

Meeting logistics:
- Duration: 30 mins (12/10/8 split)
- Recurring cadence: biweekly on Tuesdays
- Prep: I skim their PRs and the last retro notes 10m before meeting

Context / current state:
- Harper owns the replication layer work (streaming KV cache) and is the informal lead for the new batching runtime prototype.
- Recent bit: she shipped the KV cache refactor behind a feature flag (PR #318). Observability gaps: per-shard metrics missing, seeing 6–12% higher p99 latency in canary vs. baseline.
- Signals: sprint velocity slightly down (1.8 -> 1.4 storypoints/week last two sprints). Harper is hiring-contractor pairing with Maya (contractor) and is ~80% time on code, 20% on onboarding.

Agenda (compact):
1) Quick pulse (12m) — energy, priorities, immediate blockers, signal check.
2) Code & rollout (10m) — PR #318 canary anomalies, proposed mitigation, readiness to flip flag.
3) Career & tradeoffs (8m) — coaching on scope tradeoffs, delegation plan, 1 growth action for the week.

Pulse prompts (open, non-leading):
- How are you feeling about the release timeline and the current canary data? Any surprises?
- What should I know that I won't find in JIRA/PR comments?
- Do you feel overloaded with onboarding/mentoring right now?

Technical check (to surface):
- Canary p99 latency delta: verify trace id sample from last run (ask for two representative trace IDs).
- Observability: suggest adding per-shard tagging in metrics (quick experiment to roll out today?).
- Rollback plan: confirm the circuit-breaker thresholds and fallback variant if model-serving latency spikes.
- Risk tolerance: ask Harper if she wants a staged flip (10% -> 50% -> 100%) or a single flip with rollback guard.

Coaching & career (short):
- Tradeoff framework: remind Harper to use \"latency budget vs. iteration speed\" rubric when pushing scope into the sprint.
- Delegation prompt: identify 1 small task to assign to Maya this week (onboarding + light bug triage).
- Growth action: propose she publishes a 1-page "KV cache tradeoffs" note in Confluence by next Friday (helps leadership visibility).

Action items (capture during/after meeting):
- Harper: collect 3 trace IDs for the canary run and paste in this doc (due: EOD today).
- Noor (me): set up a quick dashboard to break down p99 by shard and region (due: +48h).
- Harper: write the 1-page tradeoffs note and tag me for review (due: next Fri).
- Harper: assign onboarding checklist item (contractor pairing) to Maya and add timebox (due: mid-week).

Follow-ups and signals to watch post-meeting:
- If canary p99 > baseline +10% after dashboard filters, hold rollout and open ENG-4821 subtask for mitigation.
- If Harper's capacity continues to be >15% occupied by onboarding two sprints in a row, escalate and consider re-prioritizing roadmap items.

Notes to self (manager nudges):
- Be explicit about scope-cuts: offer a concrete list of 2 lower-priority tickets we can pause if Harper's bandwidth constrained.
- Praise craft: call out the clear commit message and the unit-test coverage increase on PR #318.
- Check-in on energy: if Harper says 'frustrated' or 'blocked', move career section earlier.

Draft phrasing for feedback (if needed):
- \"You did a solid job narrowing the attack surface for the KV cache refactor. I want to partner on the rollout plan so we don't surprise downstream services.\"
- \"Let's pick one delegation slot this week — which part of the onboarding checklist can Maya own end-to-end?\"

Potential blockers to flag (to raise to SRE/platform lead if needed):
- Missing per-shard metrics in telemetry (SRE ticket ops).
- A/B experiment infra gap for staged flips (DEVOPS backlog).

Quick links (drop in during the meeting):
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/318
- Canary run: link to last canary job (add after Harper shares)
- JIRA epic: ENG-4821 (streaming KV cache)

Conversation notes (write live):
- [PLACEHOLDER] 

Post-meeting quick checklist:
- Update this doc with decisions and actual due dates (I, Noor)
- Create ENG-4821-1 subtask if we decide to pause rollout
- Send short recap to Harper with 3 bullets and assigned owners (same day)

Open questions to prepare before next 1:1:
- Do we have enough infra runway to support per-shard metrics by next sprint? (ask SRE lead)
- Is there appetite from product for an incremental rollout cadence? (sync with product PM)

Tone guide for convo: supportive, pragmatic, and data-first. Aim to unblock, not to micromanage.
